decisions.reason: The track spotlight line sits close to the core offer and has kept its own page for two years, so its results appear to meet aspirations in a growing industry and give no trigger for problemistic search.
The ceiling luminaire line has been shown steadily on its own page since 2023 and fits the established portfolio, which suggests satisfactory performance that management would keep.
The flexible spotlight line was launched only in 2024 and complements the core systems, so slack in a growing market lets the firm carry it while its results are still uncertain.
The multi-outlet canopy is a low-cost system accessory that supports the modular luminaire offer, so it is unlikely to fall far below aspiration and draw management attention.
The low-voltage canopy extends system compatibility at little resource cost and is too new to show a shortfall that would justify dropping it.

The round glass track luminaires are only mentioned rather than featured, which signals a weaker position, but one year of evidence and the firm's slack argue for keeping them rather than starting a search for other uses of the resources.
